primary.heterogeneity_status: Q = 0.368949 on 1 df, I-squared 0.0 per cent, tau-squared 0.0 under REML: the two trials agree closely. THAT AGREEMENT IS NOT THE MAIN UNCERTAINTY HERE. Both trials registered this endpoint as TIME TO FIRST EVENT and this pool combines ODDS RATIOS computed from cumulative arm counts, over trials that ran for different lengths of time. AN ODDS RATIO OVER UNEQUAL FOLLOW-UP IS NOT A HAZARD RATIO and does not become one by being pooled: it depends on how long each trial ran, so the weights do not mean what a reader would assume. Both trials published a hazard ratio and those are the right inputs. Direction and rough magnitude are not in doubt -- both favour empagliflozin, both intervals exclude no effect -- but READ THE POOLED NUMBER AS AN APPROXIMATION TO THE QUANTITY THE TRIALS ESTIMATED, NOT AS THAT QUANTITY. Two trials agreeing about an odds ratio over unequal follow-up agree about something neither of them set out to measure.

pooled.caveats: HOW THIS POOL COMBINES THE TWO TRIALS IS A WEAKER CLAIM THAN WHAT THEY MEASURED. Both trials register the SAME primary endpoint, verified word for word -- the registered strings differ only by the word 'the'. But both register it as TIME TO FIRST EVENT, and this pool combines ODDS RATIOS computed from cumulative arm counts, over trials that did not run for the same length of time. AN ODDS RATIO OVER UNEQUAL FOLLOW-UP IS NOT A HAZARD RATIO AND DOES NOT BECOME ONE BY BEING POOLED: it depends on how long each trial ran, so the weights do not mean what a reader would assume they mean. Both trials published a hazard ratio and those are the right inputs. The direction and rough magnitude here are not in doubt -- both trials favour empagliflozin and both intervals exclude no effect -- but the pooled number should be read as an approximation to the quantity the trials estimated, not as that quantity. Recorded 2026-08-20. Whether this pool is recomputed from the published hazard ratios is a decision that has been referred and not taken; the limitation is stated either way, because a reader must not be able to reach the estimate without meeting it.

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.estimator: REML with Hartung-Knapp, t on k-1 = 1 degree(s) of freedom (t = 12.7062)
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.THE_POINT_ESTIMATE_IS_UNCHANGED: The published point is 0.7576 and the house-rule point is 0.7576. THE NUMBER A READER REMEMBERS DOES NOT MOVE; what differs is the precision claim. That is why nothing downstream catches this -- every memorable quantity survives. AND BOTH INTERVALS IN THIS TABLE BRACKET AN ODDS RATIO COMPUTED OVER UNEQUAL FOLLOW-UP. Both trials registered this endpoint as time to first event; this pool combines odds ratios from cumulative arm counts over trials of different duration, and AN ODDS RATIO OVER UNEQUAL FOLLOW-UP IS NOT A HAZARD RATIO and does not become one by being pooled. Which of these two interval methods is preferred is a smaller question than which quantity is being bracketed.

published_interval.restated_2026_08_20: The published interval is now REML, so this block compares a REML point interval against a REML Hartung-Knapp one and the ESTIMATOR is no longer one of the things that differ between them. At k=2 the moment estimator and REML coincide exactly, so not one digit of this block's numbers moved -- only the label, which was wrong.

house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.variance_inflation_floor: A FLOOR OF 1 IS APPLIED TO THE VARIANCE-INFLATION FACTOR so the adjustment can never NARROW an interval below the unadjusted one. That guard is the recognised modification for exactly this instability, and its existence is evidence the small-k behaviour is a KNOWN problem with KNOWN handling rather than a novel judgement.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.no_rule_is_decided_here: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-20. The rule WAS decided, in DECISIONS-COCHRANE-2026-08-18.md section 1, and applied on 2026-08-20: REML is the estimator corpus-wide, and Hartung-Knapp is a SENSITIVITY analysis at k<=3 rather than the primary interval (Handbook 6.5 s10.10.4.4-10.10.4.5). Both intervals still stand on this page and nothing is unpublished.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.what_this_means_for_this_pool: THE PUBLISHED INTERVAL EXCLUDES 1 AND THE HOUSE-RULE INTERVAL CROSSES IT. A SIGNIFICANCE VERDICT TURNS ON THE INTERVAL METHOD ALONE. A reader shown only the published interval has been told something firmer than the evidence supports; a reader shown only the wider one loses that the contributing trials agree. BOTH ARE HERE.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.read_the_width_with_care: AT k=2 HARTUNG-KNAPP USES t ON ONE DEGREE OF FREEDOM -- 12.7062 against the normal 1.9600 -- and the interval is enormously wider. That width is a property of the method at very few studies, not a measurement of this evidence. It is recorded so a reader can see it; it is NOT presented as the better interval.
house_rule_interval_2026_08_18.a_note_written_here_does_not_reach_a_rea: This field is NOT rendered. ssot/build_app_v2.py builds the pooling-method table from `published_interval`, `estimator`, the interval bounds, `THE_POINT_ESTIMATE_IS_UNCHANGED` and `variance_inflation_floor`, and from nothing else in this block. A disclosure was appended here on 2026-08-20 and the rebuild came out byte-identical, which is how it was found. It was moved to THE_POINT_ESTIMATE_IS_UNCHANGED. Recorded so the next person does not write here either.

reviews.citation: Pan D, Xu L, Chen P, Jiang H, Shi D, Guo M. Empagliflozin in Patients With Heart Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials. Front Cardiovasc Med 2021;8:683281. doi 10.3389/fcvm.2021.683281
reviews.scope: empagliflozin against placebo in heart failure, search closed 20 January 2021
reviews.how_it_differs_from_ours: Its search closed seven months before EMPEROR-Preserved reported, and its 5,150 participants are fewer than this review's two trials alone (9,718). So it pools one of our two plus six smaller trials we do not include. INFERRED from the cut-off date and the participant total, NOT read.

reviews.citation: Banerjee M, Pal R, Nair K, Mukhopadhyay S. SGLT2 inhibitors and cardiovascular outcomes in heart failure with mildly reduced and preserved ejection fraction. Indian Heart J 2023;75(2):122-127. doi 10.1016/j.ihj.2023.03.003
reviews.scope: SGLT2 inhibitors class-wide, HFmrEF and HFpEF only
reviews.how_it_differs_from_ours: Class-wide rather than empagliflozin-only, and it EXCLUDES reduced ejection fraction, so it excludes EMPEROR-Reduced -- half of this review.

reviews.citation: Kongmalai T, et al. Comparative cardiovascular benefits of individual SGLT2 inhibitors in type 2 diabetes and heart failure: a systematic review and network meta-analysis. Front Endocrinol 2023;14:1216160. doi 10.3389/fendo.2023.1216160

reviews.how_it_differs_from_ours: A different QUESTION -- relative efficacy between agents, not the size of the effect against placebo -- and a different population frame.

divergence_decomposed.ours: Odds ratio 0.7576 (0.6825 to 0.8409) for the first occurrence of adjudicated cardiovascular death or adjudicated hospitalisation for heart failure, k=2, random effects, REML. READ WITH THE CAVEAT ON THE ESTIMATE: the trials registered a time-to-first-event endpoint and published hazard ratios; this is an odds ratio over unequal follow-up.
divergence_decomposed.theirs: RR 0.77 (0.68 to 0.87) over seven empagliflozin trials whose search predates EMPEROR-Preserved; HR 0.80 (0.74 to 0.86) over six class-wide trials restricted to preserved and mildly reduced ejection fraction; and a network analysis reporting relative rather than absolute effect.
divergence_decomposed.why_they_differ: BY TRIAL SET AND BY MEASURE, AND NOT BY DISAGREEMENT. No identified synthesis pools these two trials together on this endpoint: one predates the second trial, the other excludes the first. Every published figure points the same direction as this review and not one of them is an independent check on it. THE HONEST SUMMARY IS THAT THIS PAIRING IS UNREPLICATED, bounded by the 125 records not read.

denominator.statement: 8 checks were applied and 3 came back clean, 2 found an error, 2 found something absent and 1 could not be settled at the layer available. The denominator is stated because a list of only the failures is not a finding, it is a selection.
denominator.symmetry: Confirmations are listed in the same table, in the same detail, as errors. BOTH ERRORS FOUND ARE OURS -- a summary measure that is not the measure the trials reported, and a provenance block whose arm labels were inverted -- and the published literature is implicated in none of the rows. That is the result every cardiology topic reconciled in this corpus has produced.
denominator.what_this_denominator_does_not_cover: The 125 records the screen retrieved and did not read, and the included-study table of every one of the five it did. NO PUBLISHED TRIAL SET HERE WAS READ; all are inferred. The check count is honest about the checks and the screen is separately honest about its size.

THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2.state: A FINDING ABOUT THE EVIDENCE, NOT A COMPARISON OUTCOME
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2.what: NO IDENTIFIED SYNTHESIS POOLS EMPEROR-REDUCED WITH EMPEROR-PRESERVED ON THIS ENDPOINT, and the reason is mechanical rather than mysterious.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2.why_the_gap_exists: The closest empagliflozin-only synthesis (Pan 2021) CLOSED ITS SEARCH ON 20 JANUARY 2021 and EMPEROR-Preserved reported in August 2021, so the second trial could not have been in it. The nearest synthesis that DOES contain EMPEROR-Preserved (Banerjee 2023) is restricted to mildly reduced and preserved ejection fraction, which EXCLUDES EMPEROR-Reduced -- half of this review. One is seven months too early; the other excludes half the evidence. That is a specific account of the gap, and it is far stronger than reporting an absence.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2.so_what_it_means: This review's estimate is NEITHER CORROBORATED NOR CONTRADICTED by the identified literature. IT IS UNREPLICATED. A reader should not take the direction agreeing across every published figure as independent support, because no published figure is answering this question.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2.and_closeness_is_not_corroboration: Banerjee's HR 0.80 (0.74 to 0.86) sits close to this review's OR 0.7576 (0.6825 to 0.8409), and THAT CLOSENESS MEANS NOTHING. Different drug set -- class-wide against empagliflozin alone. Different population -- preserved and mildly reduced ejection fraction against the whole spectrum. Different measure -- a hazard ratio against an odds ratio over unequal follow-up. TWO NUMBERS THAT ARE CLOSE WHILE ANSWERING DIFFERENT QUESTIONS ARE THE THING THIS REVIEW EXISTS TO REFUSE, not evidence for it. It is recorded as UNRESOLVED in the check table for exactly that reason.
THE_FINDING_OF_THIS_COMPARISON_2026_08_2.the_bound_on_this_claim: It is 'NO IDENTIFIED SYNTHESIS', never 'no synthesis'. The screen matched 130 records, retrieved 25, appraised 5 and DID NOT READ 125. A synthesis pooling this pair could exist among them. And no included-study table was read for any of the five appraised, so even their trial sets are inferred from abstract text, participant totals and search cut-off dates.

D1_randomisation_process.reason: The registered title is 'A Phase III RANDOMISED, DOUBLE-BLIND Trial to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety of Once Daily Empagliflozin 10 mg Compared to Placebo'. D2_deviations_from_intended_intervention.basis: NOT ESTABLISHED -- OUR ACCESS, NOT THE EVIDENCE
D2_deviations_from_intended_intervention.reason: Deviations from intended intervention, and whether the analysis was by intention to treat, cannot be judged from the registration or the abstract. The full methods section states this and IS NOT OPEN ACCESS -- the PMID-to-PMCID conversion returns no PMC record for 32865377. THIS IS A LIMIT ON WHAT WE READ, NOT A GAP IN WHAT THE TRIALISTS REPORTED, and it is labelled so rather than dressed as a finding about the trial.

D3_missing_outcome_data.reason: The outcome is time-to-first-event with a registered censoring rule, so a participant who leaves the trial contributes their time at risk rather than becoming a missing value. Enrolment 3,730 is the number randomised and the number analysed in the published arms is 3,730 -- 1,863 plus 1,867 -- so no randomised participant is absent from the primary result.

D4_measurement_of_the_outcome.reason: The registered primary outcome is 'Time to First Event of ADJUDICATED Cardiovascular (CV) Death or ADJUDICATED Hospitalisation for Heart Failure (HHF)'. Both components are adjudicated, the trial is double-blind, and death and hospitalisation are not outcomes an unblinded assessor can shade. THIS JUDGEMENT IS FOR THIS RESULT ONLY -- a self-reported outcome from the same trial would need its own, and would not inherit it.

The censoring rule is registered in advance and stated verbatim: patients without an event censored at the last date known to be free of it or at the end of the planned treatment period, whichever was earlier.

risk_of_bias.ceiling: A domain that cannot be judged from the sources READ is NO_INFORMATION, never LOW. Low-by-default asserts a fact; high-by-default invents a defect. Overall is capped at SOME_CONCERNS wherever a domain is NO_INFORMATION.

access_obstacle_attempted_route_2026_08_.what_was_attempted: PMID-to-PMCID conversion for BOTH primary publications, each by name and individually: 32865377 (Packer 2020, EMPEROR-Reduced, doi 10.1056/NEJMoa2022190) and 34449189 (Anker 2021, EMPEROR-Preserved). Neither returns a PMC record.
access_obstacle_attempted_route_2026_08_.what_would_resolve_it: A route that reaches NEJM full text. NOT ANOTHER PMC QUERY -- that door is now known to be shut, and repeating it would produce the same verdict with a fresher date.
access_obstacle_attempted_route_2026_08_.why_this_is_recorded: P49. A named exit is only useful if the next person knows which door was already tried. Without the attempt on the record the next session runs the same failed query, records the same verdict, and THE REFUSAL CALCIFIES WHILE LOOKING FRESHLY CHECKED.
